name: NearMissLevelReversal
longCondition: el_ge(low[0], priorLow - marginTicks * tickSize) && el_le(low[0], priorLow + marginTicks * tickSize) && el_gt(close[0], open[0])
shortCondition: el_le(high[0], priorHigh + marginTicks * tickSize) && el_ge(high[0], priorHigh - marginTicks * tickSize) && el_lt(close[0], open[0])
